_comment: Generic config for lib/domain_invariants.py: a domain invariant (INV-NN, or the prefix config/project.json declares) is a list of regex 'signals' with file:line evidence. 'scope' is 'all' (all production code, src/main/** of the modules declared in settings.gradle) or 'critical' (only the paths listed in config/project.json:critical_paths; the deprecated spellings 'money' and money_paths are still read). 'match' is 'line' (searches each line, comments already stripped) or 'filename' (searches the file name, without looking at content). This does NOT prove the invariant holds: it is a PRESENCE detector -- empty evidence is a valid finding, not an error. Full example instantiated over a critical-flow domain in config/examples/critical-flow/invariants-checks.json.

INV-01.note: minimal example: spots that leave a TODO with no associated ticket in production code
